'''Garlic''' is a [[Vegetables|vegetable]] [[Crops|crop]] that grows from [[Garlic Seeds]] after 4 days.  The seeds are available at [[Pierre's General Store]] starting in Year 2. One Garlic can sometimes be purchased for {{Price|2500}} from [[Pierre]]'s booth at the [[Feast of the Winter Star]].

==Tailoring==
Garlic can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[Tailoring|Shirt And Belt]].  [[File:Shirt159.png|24px]]

==Quests==
*A fully-grown and unharvested Garlic is required for [[Ginger Island#Gourmand Frog|Gourmand Frog's puzzle]] on [[Ginger Island]].
